verdict.rationale: Databricks documents automatic versioning for notebooks, Delta table time-travel/rollback, and Unity Catalog lineage/audit logging, which together cover generic version/review/rollback capabilities, but none of this evidence explicitly ties into versioning or rolling back Lakeflow pipelines/Jobs (the actual 'automations') rather than notebooks/tables. Missing for 10: explicit job/pipeline version history and rollback workflow, CI/CD or git-based pipeline versioning evidence, and any hands-on confirmation of rolling back an automation run.
